author: potuz
content:
This is going to be a raw unedited braindump at midnight.

I an exactly at 12:14 am writing this. This is Thursday, well, now Friday, the 6th of November 2026.
I used to say that I didn't care, but tonight, I couldn't hold the tears in Lion's shoulders.  So lets get to this.

We live in a place in which we think we make some decisions, and we know we don't but we all like to pretend otherwise. At any rate, we all
play with that room in which decisions are made and we are not there but we are often times aligned with them so we let it go. We have found our
friends, our allies. people we learned to trust, people that slowly have became our anchor to reality.

Every year since I came I saw part of the public vs private aspects of the decision making process. I met Francesco when he was still a student, and Barnabé had just graduated. I saw Tim's hugging Danno
when EOF got CFId, I spent hours arguring forkchoice with a guy whom I didn't know from Australia. I feel still awkward talking to Felix. And I dislike that I am absolutely certain that both Marius and Matt like me
but we can't be really be close because I see them 10 minutes a year.

I haven't even talked about the people I work every day with, like Terence who has put at least 8 years in this. Nor about any of the other CL devs that are a long list to mention at this pissed off hour.

author: potuz
content:
At any rate. I flew across the world to be here. The very one trip a year that I do to have some human connection with this world that is already alien to me. I came with high hopes that I would meet friends, celebrate the impending success of Gloas, the culmination of years of work. I needed to touch grass with Justin to reassert that we are both in the same team, to thank him to bear with me throughout the year. Instead, I found myself held in a room, all, day, every day, for a week. Working under the impression that it was necessary, that it was what we needed to do to save the chain. That we were the only ones that could do this and we really had to do this.

Now I need to go back, I have lost my chance to actually connect with the people I care about, to have a moment of joy, to even attend a talk at fucking Devcon. I feel my time is worth much more than this. As it was in Svanlbard. I am angry, dissapointed, feel used, stupid, and ultimately I feel like I have played a key role in someone's chess game. I don't know who's reading this far. Bur the pressure is real. I want to be out and many are feeling the same. If the people that care the most want to be out that should be a signal that something is wrong.

content: Let's say that I missed both my wife's and my son's birthday to be here, and I regret that deeply
